title: Extended ACL Blocking Return Traffic
symptoms: Users on VLAN 10 can initiate connections to VLAN 20 but get no response
The TCP SYN packets reach VLAN 20 (confirmed by packet capture)
VLAN 20 server logs show no incoming connections
Removing the ACL between VLANs restores connectivity
rootCause: The extended ACL applied inbound on VLAN 10 permits outbound traffic but the 'established' keyword is missing, so return traffic from VLAN 20 is dropped. Without 'established' or 'reflexive', the ACL is stateless and blocks responses.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the ACL definition applied to the VLAN 10 interface?
steps.hint: Look for an entry permitting TCP with no 'established' keyword.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the ACL hit counters to confirm what's being dropped?
steps.hint: The deny entries at the bottom should show high hit counts.

steps.prompt: Which command shows which interfaces the ACL is applied to?
steps.hint: Confirm the direction (in/out) matches what you intended.
